acceptance_gate_results.principle: Only the resolved V643 roadmap can supply executable rows.
Every literal row and field must match before the advisory score is one.
Named mutations prove the comparison can fail.
Exact copies keep later document edits from changing this result.
Score and terminal-class gates must fail closed through the actual reader.
Literature access can fail, but every bounded decision must remain in the record.
No current model call may decorate an aggregation receipt.
An affected check failure disqualifies current work.

field_principles.completed_at_utc: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.contract_complete_score: One only for the exact thirteen-row contract and passing metadata checks.
field_principles.contract_mutation_rows: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.contract_passed: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.contract_rows: Both independently parsed authorities retain every compared field.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure real elapsed time; never sleep or inflate counts to satisfy a floor.
field_principles.execution_host: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use host for this milestone; historical board work is not current board execution.
field_principles.experiment_id: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.field_principles: Explain why each field exists without wrapping executable scalars or ordinary dictionaries.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* names upstream, check, artifact field, expected value, and observed value.
field_principles.gate_control_rows: Actual file-to-reader tests preserve the expected and observed result.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_ or complete:; external absence starts blocked_. State the actual result.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe actual computation using the recognized substrate literal.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use model_full_generation, model_bounded_generation, model_load_no_generation, cpu_exact_solver_or_simulator, or aggregation as actually exercised.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted, completed, failed, cancelled, and in-flight loads and generations.

field_principles.markdown_milestone: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.

field_principles.milestone: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.model_invoked: True for any actual attempted load or generation, including unusable results.
field_principles.passed: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.phase_spans: Record disjoint elapsed spans, units, checkpoint boundaries, and pending operations.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record input identities, availability, and the exact failed check.
field_principles.random_seed: Seal independent development and evaluation seeds before observing results.
field_principles.raw_authority_rows: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.repository_health: Preserve dated unrelated failures as observations, never as passed required checks.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, public inputs, private evaluator identity, settings, and raw evidence.
field_principles.required_checks_passed: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.rows: Emit every comparative unit and arm with metrics, costs, failures, abstentions, and censoring.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260915; preserve actual UTC timestamps and monotonic phase spans.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, complete, and censored counts and the frozen stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version this artifact; keep ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.sidecar_receipts: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate exact producers; historical diagnostic evidence cannot authorize readiness.
field_principles.source_dispositions: Cite dates, URLs, access results, implementation choices, and falsifiers.
field_principles.started_at_utc: This field keeps the V643 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.status: Write terminal output only after current work and required validation.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Keep exact commands, scopes, exit codes, elapsed times, and log hashes, including failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed enum: positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only unfinished own work is partial; unchanged external failure is blocked.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Declare shared executor authority; true forbids a positive scientific class.
